text:
dimitri: Quick follow-up from last night's token-validation incident. Short summary: third-party signing key expired unexpectedly, permission-canary not deployed to two regions, audit events missing user_id on /token/refresh. Posting consolidated action items here so we don't lose track. Please ack and call dibs. :warning:

felix: i'll take the key rotation automation + CI dry-run. planning to add a workflow in .github/workflows/rotate-keys.yml and a dry-run job. ETA 2026-04-02. need a KMS policy tweak (iam:Decrypt for rotation-sa).

nora: i can own the audit schema + event emitter. will add user_id and request_id to token refresh and revoke events. est 1.5 sprints, can compress if we freeze a few infra-adjacent PRs.

yvonne: i'll do the permission canary and pre-deploy smoke tests. plan: two pytest cases and a tiny node script that exercises token routes. datadog alert will be created to surface missing user_id as well. target 2026-03-30.

sec-bot: Reminder: owners must acknowledge within 24h or action escalates to security. Tracker: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2071-remediate. Auto-remind in 48h.

felix: proposed datadog logs query for canary (tweak as needed):

```
logs("service:auth AND http.path:/token/* AND !user_id").index("*").rollup("count").last("15m") > 3
```

opts: pls route this alert to #eng-oncall and set pager after 2 consecutive fires.

ops: confirmed — will configure alert routing. on-prem maintenance window suggested: 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC. managed customers need notice by 2026-04-03. air-gapped installs require manual coord.

dimitri: rollback plan: staged swap with old key valid 48h; rotation script supports --staged and --rollback. example: `./tools/rotate-keys --staged --verify`. i'll document steps in the runbook.

nora: migration note: consumers of audit stream should tolerate absent user_id for 2 weeks; we'll emit both old and new schemas during transition. i'll add compatibility tests.

yvonne: added a short playbook snippet: if canary fires pre-deploy, block rollout and ping oncall; if post-deploy, run `scripts/rotate-keys --rollback` and open an incident.

felix: checklist added to tracker card (copied here): - [ ] GH workflow + CI dry-run (felix) - [ ] KMS policy update + sec approval (felix + security) - [ ] Audit events patch + migration (nora) - [ ] Permission canary + tests (yvonne) - [ ] Playbook/runbook update (dimitri + yvonne) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

dimitri: acked.

nora: acked.

yvonne: acked.

sec-bot: Actions acknowledged. Reminder: update tracker with PR links when available. Next quick sync Thu 09:00 to review blockers. Leaving thread open for status updates. :spiral_calendar_pad:
